note: results/ is gitignored by design (evidence branch policy): the raw run directories and REQUALIFICATION_STATUS.md ship in the evidence package, not the source archive. This manifest is the source-archive record of what was executed and what it means — including, explicitly, the null result.

sealed_holdout.custody: digest-bound into campaign configs; the runner/learner never opens it

hidden_generalization.verdict: NULL RESULT — no held-out improvement; reported as such

historical_requalification.meaning: v1-casefold-era reported metrics are superseded; strict-era (c3b3) runs verify byte-exact

G1_evaluator_correctness.evidence: declarative-evaluator-v2 strict-by-default; 20 regression tests; score_row dispatch on all lanes

G2_experimental_completeness.evidence: experiment_matrix.audit_matrix wired into qualifier as matrix_audit; INCOMPLETE/INCONSISTENT states enforced

G3_genuine_learning.evidence: executed run: hidden 0.333 -> 0.333; no held-out improvement demonstrated — honest negative

G4_retention.evidence: 1/4 frozen-correct destroyed, 1 gained; regression bound machinery in place (retention split + destruction accounting)

G5_transfer.evidence: compositional/cross-family splits exist and are measured by the runner; no executed claim made

G6_cost.evidence: controller records compute/storage/overhead cost fields; training receipts bind duration and batch schedule

G7_independence.evidence: qualifier rescores from persisted predictions; unsigned authority forces INVALID_EVIDENCE; holdout never opened by worker

G8_reproducibility.evidence: manifest+receipt digest binding verified; independent rerun of v40-verify-s0 not yet executed on a second host

limitations: Campaign colab lane requires CUDA; v4.0 changes verified by unit/integration tests plus the CPU/MPS positive-control run, not a new full campaign.
Key custody is single-host development custody; no multi-party approval or HSM.
No claim of recursive self-improvement or demonstrated capability acquisition is made — G3 is NOT MET on the executed evidence.
